# Jack Ferrence

> Websites for service companies in SoCal.

Jack Ferrence builds fast, mobile-first marketing websites and sets up Google Business Profiles for owner-operated service companies across Orange County and coastal Southern California. He is based in Newport Beach and specializes in marine trades around Newport Harbor.

## Contact

- Phone: (702) 817-8753
- Email: jackferrence11@gmail.com

## Primary services

- Google Business Profile setup: $400
- Domain and business email setup: $200
- One-page website: $900, typically one week
- Three-page website: $1,600, typically two weeks
- Five-page website: $2,400, typically three weeks
- Extra service page: $250
- On-site photo session: $350
- Review request system: $200
- Website care: $100/month
- Website Care+: $175/month
- À la carte support: $80/hour

## Bundles

- Dock: $1,400
- Harbor: $2,400
- Full Slip: $3,300

## Process

1. A 20-minute call with Jack
2. A short intake with the business basics
3. A custom mockup within one week
4. Build, approval, and launch about two weeks later for a typical three-page site

Copywriting is included. The client does not need to draft the website copy.

## About Jack

Jack earned a B.S. in Computer Science from Biola University in 2026 with a 3.65 GPA. He has worked as a freelance web developer since 2025 using React, Next.js, Astro, and Netlify, including ongoing client-site maintenance and production troubleshooting. He built an interactive product prototype for Global Infrared for a live pitch with a major prospective client and previously managed a new Shopify product-line storefront during an internship with ArmaJoint. He created Dobber, a live multiplayer sports-bingo application, and built a UFC fight prediction model that reached 69% accuracy against bookmaker odds. He is a former NCAA Division II decathlete and PacWest Conference Champion.
